name: Ordinary Member
eligibility: An individual aged eighteen or over.
terms: Admission is by application and approval by the Board or a committee it appoints.
Pays an annual subscription fixed by the Board.
benefits: Take part in programmes, Special Interest Groups, events and publications, as the Board decides.

name: Life Member
eligibility: An individual recommended by two trustees.
terms: Admission is by application and approval by the Board or a committee it appoints.
Pays a one-time amount fixed by the Board.
benefits: Take part in programmes, Special Interest Groups, events and publications, as the Board decides.

name: Associate Member
eligibility: An institution, organisation, society or company.
terms: Admission is by application and approval by the Board or a committee it appoints.
Pays a fee fixed by the Board.
Is represented by an official it nominates.
benefits: Take part in programmes, Special Interest Groups, events and publications, as the Board decides.

name: Honorary Member
terms: Admitted without a fee by a resolution passed by two-thirds of the Board.
Membership lasts three years and may be renewed.
benefits: Take part in programmes, Special Interest Groups, events and publications, as the Board decides.
